description: This file defines the class AdoNetGatewayListProvider which implements IGatewayListProvider. It provides functionality to retrieve a list of gateway URIs by querying an ADO.NET database, including initialization, logging, and error handling.

classes.name: AdoNetGatewayListProvider
classes.description: Implements IGatewayListProvider to fetch gateway URIs from an ADO.NET data source, managing initialization, refresh logic, and logging.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the provider, establishing database queries.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the list of active gateway URIs from the database.
